heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 97–35, title IX, § 902(e)(1), Aug. 13, 1981, 95 Stat. 560

notes.text: Section 9451, Pub. L. 96–398, title III, § 301, Oct. 7, 1980, 94 Stat. 1585, set forth requirements for State mental health services programs.
Section 9452, Pub. L. 96–398, title III, § 302, Oct. 7, 1980, 94 Stat. 1585, related to contents of programs with respect to administrative and service parts.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Oct. 1, 1981, see section 902(h) of Pub. L. 97–35, set out as an Effective Date of 1981 Amendment note under section 238l of this title.
